General Virtual Assistant · Executive Support

Structure around the work — not more noise.

I support owners and remote teams by keeping information organized, routine work moving, and decisions clearly separated from tasks that can be handled independently.

How I work

Protect attention. Keep visibility high.

  • Inbox & communication: sort by urgency, handle routine items within authority, flag what needs a decision, and keep open threads visible.
  • Task & project coordination: use Notion, Asana, ClickUp, Sheets, and structured trackers to make owners, status, deadlines, and blockers easy to scan.
  • Documentation: turn repeat work into checklists and SOPs so handoffs are cleaner and the same issue does not need to be explained twice.
  • Executive support: take routine operational concerns through completion and escalate only the items that genuinely need owner input.
  • Research & records: collect, verify, organize, and present information in a format that is easy to act on.

Creative Direction

How I guide the shot before the edit.

I prefer to solve content problems at capture stage. A clear shot list gives the editor better material, gives the brand more consistency, and makes one filming session useful across several posts.

01

Hook

Lead with the strongest visual within the first seconds.

02

Problem

Show the friction or context so the benefit makes sense.

03

Solution

Introduce the product quickly and make its role obvious.

04

Process

Hands-on detail, close-ups, action, and proof.

05

Result

Show the finished result, fit, or useful feature payoff.

06

Real use

Put the product back into the real-world context.

Angles

Hero front view, close-up detail, wide context, side profile, over-the-shoulder, process/action, and finished result.

B-roll

Textures, tools, hands, motion, setup, packaging, workspace, creator reaction, and extra transition footage.

Camera notes

Vertical 9:16 for short-form, clean light, stable movement, several angles, and enough hold time for editing.

Edit goal

Fast, clear, product-focused pacing with simple text support and no unnecessary effects.

Customer Support · E-commerce CX

Calm communication, clean documentation, clear next steps.

My support background spans e-commerce, Meta account and verification cases, U.S. healthcare member support, and general customer service. I focus on understanding the issue first, solving what I can, and escalating with enough context for the next person to act quickly.

Support queue · example workflow

Shopify

Meta

UHC

Customer call or message

Listen, ask focused questions, keep the tone calm, confirm the next step, and leave complete notes.

CSR
